text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho!! Did I manage to shine once 
again today, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Before my beauty, cracking open a sea 
urchin with my bare hands was a total 
breeze!! Ho-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!!" his

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That was another splendid run today, 
Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flash! You were looking pretty sharp 
out there yourself!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Enough to scare the living daylights out 
of even a notorious, vicious great white 
shark!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much... By the way, 
about the promised item...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Here. Please accept this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this? It's got "Su" written on 
it. ...What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but I cannot say 
anything further. If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
She took off... Seriously makes zero 
sense. What the heck is 'S' supposed to 
mean?

The note I got from Eishin Flash before 
said I needed to collect 4 keywords to 
reach Eden, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Oh, the keyword for Eden! Yeah, 
there was something like that! Totally 
forgot about it though!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Which means if I keep entering races from 
here on out, I'll gather the keywords.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah! Sounds like fun! I'm gonna 
collect all four of 'em!!"

Afterward, while having a meal with Gold 
Ship at the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you know how many seeds are on a 
single strawberry?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The answer is... between 100 and 500, pal.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, today I'm in a strawberry mood♪ 
I'm gonna Gol-snatch that limited-edition 
strawberry mille-feuille for myself~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, snagged the very last 
mille-feuille by chance! Lucky me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's still one left~! Maybe today's 
my super lucky day~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's your problem, punk... Are you 
trying to steal my beloved mille-feuille 
from me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's my line. Can you get out of 
the way?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm definitely not backing down 
here! Not on my pride!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, you and I have had stuff 
like this happen a lot, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At times bickering over the temperature of 
hot milk, and at other times bickering 
over the angle of a beret.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At times they bickered over the number of 
bumps on a bitter melon, and at other 
times over the thickness of the yakitori 
sauce.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I don't remember a single bit of that, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you and I were destined to always be 
at odds...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've decided! Forget this petty 
bickering, face me in a fair-and-square 
match!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Proud and magnificent, on the grand stage 
of racing!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? In a race?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it... but it kinda 
pisses me off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna push it that far, maybe 
I'll pay back everything they threw at me. 
For real.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for real, for real! Let's clash with 
everything we've got!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, you're the one person I 
absolutely won't lose to!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's my damn line, oraah!! I'm gonna go 
all out and kick your ass! Ora ora 
oraaahh!!

In the brief moment I took my eyes off 
her, it seems things have escalated into 
quite a mess—

It's wonderful to have rivals to compete 
with. I'll do everything I can to support 
Gold Ship.
